text: Managing a team is a skill that requires effort and patience. First, clear communication is essential: team members need to understand their tasks and goals. Good leaders also know how to delegate work, giving each person responsibilities that match their strengths. Providing regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued, which increases motivation. When conflicts appear, a good manager listens to both sides and finds a fair solution. Finally, recognising achievements and supporting team members keeps everyone positive and productive. By combining these skills, a manager can build a strong, successful team.
